- VideoSave, Node.js, and MCP client versions / VideoSave、Node.js 与 MCP 客户端版本
- Standalone or paired mode, operating system / 独立或配对模式、操作系统
- Tool name, sanitized error code, and steps to reproduce / 工具名、脱敏错误码与复现步骤
- Expected behavior / 预期表现

Run `get_version` if available. Review all diagnostics before posting and remove tokens, pairing codes, Cookies, signed URLs, and local paths. / 如可用请运行 `get_version`。公开前请检查诊断并移除令牌、配对码、Cookie、签名链接和本地路径。
